FreeSurround
    Christian Kothe, 2007-2010
    GNU General Public License v2 or later (see LICENSE)

    Taken from dolphin-emu/dolphin, Externals/FreeSurround/, which is the only
    copy that is built and exercised. Upstream — the foobar2000 DSP component
    foo_dsp_fsurround — is abandoned and publishes no releases, so every
    surviving copy is a fork.

    Vendored rather than depended on because no packaged form of it exists.

    Includes KissFFT (Mark Borgerding, BSD 3-Clause), which Dolphin's copy
    inlines as KissFFT.cpp / KissFFTR.cpp / _KissFFTGuts.h.

    Not taken from github.com/tygyh/FreeSurround despite that being the
    standalone-library form: it sets kiss_fft_scalar to float while leaving the
    decoder's cplx at std::complex<double>, so its FFT writes 8-byte complexes
    into a buffer read as 16-byte ones. Its CMakeLists and exports.props restore
    nothing, and the latter still references a Dolphin path, so it has not been
    built.

    Dolphin's copy declares lt/rt/dst as std::vector<double> rather than
    std::vector<kiss_fft_scalar>. That is load-bearing: it makes the precision
    invariant a compile error rather than silent corruption. Any change to
    kiss_fft_scalar must change cplx and those three vectors together.

    Dolby Laboratories. This is an independent implementation of expired art and
